svg.text: stock Claude Code / Codex, sampled N times per task · recording hooks only — nothing blocks, nothing is injected
the solver's distribution is untouched; it is never told what to prove
each run leaves a trace behind — scored only after it is finished
VERIFIER · SCORES EACH TRACE IN ISOLATION — ×N GRAPHS, NOTHING SHARED · FAIL-CLOSED
verdict, counterexamples & certificate return to the live solver
the ledger and the delivered state
bad refs retried ≤3 · verdicts NEVER flow back (outcome-blind)
on the final's slice is verified
KERNEL — verifies one claim at a time
lazy: wakes when the certificate pulls the final's slice
compiles each claim into world-checkable obligations
answer-blind: sees the graph, never the argument
residual on verified premises · reuses proven text verbatim
past ⇒ ledger obligations · present ⇒ the delivered world
builds a world where every obligation
holds and the claim is still false
refuted ⇒ short-circuit with a witness · exhausted ⇒ failed · faithful ⇒ bound
CERTIFICATE — the final claim's slice, frozen
claims nest their obligation nodes and evidence · verdict is the worst case — it never rounds up
no tuned weights — only an order
argmax by rank, or verdict-weighted voting when answers are comparable
the same N candidates go to the LLM-as-a-Verifier baseline — head-to-head on identical traces
online mode — feedback to the solver (not ORM)
